description: There is no way to browse by folder: no folder rows, tree or breadcrumb. The dim directory text in each row looks navigable but is inert.
expected: Clicking a directory segment (or a folder row) narrows the list to that folder, with a breadcrumb to go back up.
actual: Click and double-click do nothing; only a substring filter exists.
suggested_fix: Make each path segment a button that sets the filter to that prefix, and show a clearable breadcrumb chip above the table.

description: The filter is a substring match on loaded rows only. Rows beyond the first 100 are invisible to it until 'Load more files' is clicked; the user must know to do that.
expected: A path-prefix filter that queries the server (the list API supports prefix).
actual: /reports/q3/ returned 'No loaded files match' until Load more was clicked.
suggested_fix: Pass the typed prefix to the list API when it starts with '/'.
